table.label: Table 3
table.caption: Table 3 Analyst Coverage and Corporate Investment
table.notes: This table reports OLS regressions of next-year investment on analyst coverage. Variables are defined in Appendix A. Standard errors clustered by firm are reported in parentheses. ***, **, and * denote significance at the 1%, 5%, and 10% levels, respectively.

model_name: mock: hand-written fixture — replace by a real live-mode run

evidence.quote: Our sample covers fiscal years 2003 to 2019.
We obtain financial statement data from Compustat, stock price data from CRSP, and analyst coverage from I/B/E/S.

items.label: Sample filters
value: Require non-missing values for all regression variables
Require lagged total assets of at least $10 million

evidence.quote: We exclude financial firms (SIC codes 6000-6999) and utilities (SIC codes 4900-4999)
We require non-missing values for all regression variables and lagged total assets of at least $10 million.
The unit of observation is the firm-year.

items.label: Dependent variable
items.value: INVEST: Capital expenditures (CAPX) in year t+1 divided by total assets (AT) in year t

evidence.quote: INVEST Capital expenditures (CAPX) in year t+1 divided by total assets (AT) in year t.

items.label: Key independent variable(s)
value: COVERAGE: Natural log of one plus the number of analysts with an annual EPS forecast (I/B/E/S)

evidence.quote: COVERAGE Natural log of one plus the number of analysts with an annual EPS forecast (I/B/E/S).

items.label: Control variables
value: SIZE: Natural log of total assets (AT)
LEV: Long-term debt plus debt in current liabilities (DLTT + DLC) divided by AT
MTB: Market value of equity (PRCC_F x CSHO) divided by book equity (CEQ)
CASH: Cash and short-term investments (CHE) divided by AT
ROA: Income before extraordinary items (IB) divided by AT

evidence.quote: SIZE Natural log of total assets (AT).
ROA Income before extraordinary items (IB) divided by AT.
Column (2) adds SIZE, LEV and MTB, and column (3) further adds CASH and ROA.
Firm fixed effects absorb time-invariant differences in investment policy, and year fixed effects absorb aggregate shocks.
Standard errors are clustered at the firm level.
We estimate all models using ordinary least squares (OLS).

items.label: Subsamples / column structure
items.value: Same sample in all columns; column 1 includes only COVERAGE, column 2 adds SIZE, LEV and MTB, column 3 adds CASH and ROA

evidence.quote: Column (2) adds SIZE, LEV and MTB, and column (3) further adds CASH and ROA.

items.label: Winsorization / outliers
items.value: Continuous variables winsorized at the 1% and 99% levels

evidence.quote: All continuous variables are winsorized at 1% and 99% to remove outliers.
